response.rationale: A Treatment Product is a catalog item (e.g. a medication), stored in its own TreatmentProductRepository (TreatmentService calls TreatmentProductRepository.create/findAll/findById). A Treatment is an event of applying a treatment to a hive, stored in TreatmentRepository (`private readonly items: Treatment[] = [];`) and looked up by hive (findByHive). TreatmentService uses both repositories separately, so these are two related but different concepts: a treatment likely refers to a product, but they are not the same thing.
